mods.name: Bosses Have Gp Coins
mods.description: Bosses can drop GP coins, same idea as Lega medals but for the GP coin grind.

mods.name: Season Rotator
mods.description: Cycles map seasons on a timer so raids are not stuck in one weather look forever.

mods.name: Canted Aiming
mods.description: Lets you point-shoot / cant the gun without needing a backup sight mount.

mods.name: Default Fire Mode Fixer
mods.description: Fixes weapons that spawn on the wrong fire selector so full-auto / burst guns start in a sensible mode.

mods.name: Crates In Airdrop
mods.description: Airdrops can contain loot crates instead of only spilling loose items.

mods.name: Item Limits Begone!
mods.description: Removes or raises stash, trader, and related item limits that block stacking or buying.

mods.name: Cultist Circle Improvements
mods.description: Lets us tune Cultist Circle timers, costs, and rewards, including extra direct-reward crafts.

mods.name: Add Secret Exfil Notes to Caches
mods.description: Secret extract requirement notes can spawn in caches instead of only their vanilla sources.

mods.name: FIR Fence Purchases
mods.description: Items bought from Fence count as Found in Raid.

mods.name: Item Property Backport
mods.description: Applies live-patch item stat and balance changes onto our SPT item data.

mods.name: Advanced Flea Simulator
mods.description: Makes the flea market feel closer to live: offers, pricing, and player-like listings instead of a static vendor board.

mods.name: Funtar
mods.description: Reworks UNTAR so those scavs are actually worth fighting instead of a boring sideshow.

mods.name: Transits Count
mods.description: Map transits count as extracts for quests and raid completion, matching how people actually play SPT.

mods.name: Raids Are Infinite
mods.description: Removes the raid timer so you are not forced out when the clock hits zero.

mods.name: Ref - SPT Friendly Quests
mods.description: Adjusts Ref's quests so they work in SPT instead of requiring live-only Arena / multiplayer steps.

mods.name: APBS - Acid's Progressive Bot System
mods.description: Bots gear up over the wipe instead of everyone spawning in endgame kits. Core of how CampD PMC/scav loadouts scale.

mods.name: Bosses Have Lega Medals
mods.description: Bosses can drop Lega medals so those are not flea-only.

mods.name: All The Clothes
mods.description: Unlocks the full clothing catalog instead of drip-feeding outfits through traders.

mods.name: Scorpion
mods.description: Adds a large extra quest line (100+ tasks), including timed event quests, available from the start of the wipe.

mods.name: LootNET
mods.description: Shows a running total of how much the raid's loot is worth so you know if the kit was worth the risk.

mods.name: UI Fixes
mods.description: Bundle of stash, inspect, and menu QoL fixes. Several other client mods plug into this.

mods.name: WTT - CommonLib
mods.description: Shared library required by the other WTT mods. Not useful on its own.

mods.name: WTT - Head and Voice Selector
mods.description: Lets you pick PMC head and voice independently in character creation.

mods.name: WTT - Content Backport
mods.description: Backports later-wipe items, gear, and related content into our SPT build.

mods.name: Content Backport - Prestiges
mods.description: Adds prestige progression on top of the content backport so prestige rewards exist in SPT.

mods.name: Blackout
mods.description: Recreates the Labs blackout event: real darkness, locked extracts, and keypad doors when the power dies.

mods.name: Weekend Drops
mods.description: Rotating daily and weekend challenges that pay crates and GP coins.

mods.name: EasyMounting
mods.description: Relaxes weapon attachment rules so more optics, grips, and mounts actually fit together.

mods.name: ReceiveAllChats
mods.description: Lets you see all in-raid chat channels instead of missing squad / system messages.

mods.name: Operator Traits
mods.description: Zomboid-style positive and negative traits on the profile so each PMC does not play identical.

mods.name: PMC Spawn Toggle
mods.description: Toggle whether AI PMCs spawn, without ripping out the rest of the bot stack.

mods.name: Dynamic Maps
mods.description: In-raid map overlay that updates with extracts, player position, and related markers.
mods.settingsNotes: Special non-mod folder data ships with this pack in addition to the Forge mod.

mods.name: ABPS - Acid's Bot Placement System
mods.description: Controls spawn waves, starting PMCs, and boss chances so raids stay populated and not identical every run.

mods.name: Gilded Key Storage
mods.description: A proper key holder so keys are not eating stash slots one cell at a time.

mods.name: BrightLasers
mods.description: Makes laser and light beams actually visible in raid instead of a faint smudge.

mods.name: MergeConsumables
mods.description: Lets you combine stacks of meds, food, and other consumables in stash.

mods.name: Bot Callsigns - Reloaded
mods.description: Huge pool of bot names so you are not fighting the same dozen callsigns every raid.

mods.name: StatTrack
mods.description: Tracks kills and related stats on weapons so you can see what a gun has actually done.

mods.name: BarterItemsStacks
mods.description: Raises stack sizes on barter items so junk loot does not fill the stash.

mods.name: Vertical Hideout
mods.description: Replaces the hideout's horizontal carousel with a vertical list that is actually usable.

mods.name: BALL - Better Ammo Loading List
mods.description: Cleaner ammo selection UI when loading mags, with stats that are easier to compare.

mods.name: More Tag Colours
mods.description: Extra item tag colors for stash organization.

mods.name: LetMeRightClick
mods.description: Restores right-click context menus in places the vanilla UI blocks them.

mods.name: Discarder
mods.description: Quick-discard items from stash without the usual confirm dance.

mods.name: Dev Balaclava Fix
mods.description: Fixes the dev balaclava clipping / rendering so it does not sit wrong on the head.

mods.name: EOTech Fix
mods.description: Corrects EOTech sight picture / reticle issues that make those holos unusable.

mods.name: Dynamic Item Weights
mods.description: Container and mag weight reflects what is actually inside instead of a flat empty weight.

mods.name: No Barrel Shadow
mods.description: Removes the fake barrel shadow overlay that darkens the bottom of the screen while aiming.

mods.name: LET ME OUT
mods.description: Using a transit no longer disables every other extract. You can still leave the normal way.

mods.name: AutoRun
mods.description: Toggle autorun so you are not holding W across the whole map.

mods.name: knife sprint
mods.description: Lets you sprint with melee out instead of being forced to walk.

mods.name: ScopeRangefinder
mods.description: Shows range-to-target while using scopes so you can hold over without a dedicated rangefinder.

mods.name: Auto Shoulder Swap
mods.description: Automatically switches shoulders around cover instead of a manual toggle every peek.

mods.name: RaidMenuCleanupFix
mods.description: Fixes raid-end / menu cleanup so leftover UI does not stick around after extracts.

mods.name: Chamber Ammo Info
mods.description: Shows what round is in the chamber on the inspect / loadout UI.

mods.name: No Version Label in Raid
mods.description: Hides the SPT version watermark while you are in raid.

mods.name: Parmesan - Partizan Rework
mods.description: Makes Partizan hunt AI PMCs instead of tunnel-visioning the player every raid.

mods.name: Preview Sizer
mods.description: Lets you scale item 3D previews so inspect windows are readable.

mods.name: AutoKeycard for Labs
mods.description: Automatically uses a Labs keycard when you enter, so you are not dragging it onto the slot every raid.

mods.name: Adaptive Bot Culling
mods.description: Pauses bot brains and animations when they are culled, which cuts CPU when lots of AI are around corners.

mods.name: TraderSearch
mods.description: Search box on trader inventories so you can find an item without scrolling the whole stock.

mods.name: LinkedSearchInStash
mods.description: Linked-search works in stash the same way it does on the flea.

mods.name: REDACTED Redactor
mods.description: Cleans up [REDACTED] labels in the UI so censored location names read normally.

mods.name: Ragdoll Kinetics
mods.description: Death ragdolls keep momentum and joint motion instead of collapsing into a stiff T-pose pile.

mods.name: NotificationFilter
mods.description: Filter or mute notification spam (quests, traders, mail) so the corner of the screen stays readable.

mods.name: Tarkin's Hideout Cat
mods.description: Adds a cat in the hideout. That is the feature.

mods.name: Task Search
mods.description: Search and filter the tasks screen instead of scrolling the entire quest list.

mods.name: StashFilter
mods.description: Filter stash contents by type or name so finding gear in a huge stash is faster.

mods.name: BigBrain
mods.description: Bot-brain framework other AI mods depend on. Required support mod, not a gameplay toggle by itself.

mods.name: Waypoints - Expanded Navmesh
mods.description: Extra navmesh so bots can path through more of the map instead of getting stuck on vanilla meshes.

mods.name: Amands's Graphics
mods.description: In-raid graphics controls (sharpen, color, post-fx). Used together with the Sharper ReSHADE preset; turn off EFT's own sharpen.

mods.name: Search Open Containers
mods.description: Lets you loot already-opened containers without searching them again.

mods.name: Quest Tracker
mods.description: Toggleable in-raid overlay for tracked quest objectives.

mods.name: HandsAreNotBusy
mods.description: Stops the game from blocking actions just because your hands are "busy" inspecting or looting.

mods.name: Quick Move To Containers
mods.description: Ctrl-click items straight into open containers instead of dragging every stack.

mods.name: Kaeno-TraderScrolling
mods.description: Makes trader stock lists actually scroll instead of cutting off items.

mods.name: Continuous Healing
mods.description: Healing items keep applying without re-clicking every limb.

mods.name: Use Loose Loot
mods.description: Use meds, keys, and consumables straight off the ground without picking them up first.

mods.name: AutoDeposit
mods.description: One-action deposit from raid loot / sorting table into stash.

mods.name: Player Encumbrance Bar
mods.description: On-screen weight bar so you can see overweight / overweight-heavy before you start waddling.

mods.name: VRAM Cleaner
mods.description: Frees unused VRAM between raids / menus to cut stutter on long sessions.

mods.name: Task List Fixes
mods.description: Fixes quest list layout and filtering bugs in the tasks screen.

mods.name: Amands' Sense - Updated
mods.description: World icons for loot, containers, bodies, and extracts (loot-sense style highlights).

mods.name: Fast Sell In Flea
mods.description: Speeds up listing items on the flea so you are not clicking through the full sell flow every stack.

mods.name: Door Randomizer
mods.description: Randomizes which doors start open/closed/locked so map knowledge is not a static script.

mods.name: NerfBotGrenades
mods.description: Makes bot grenades less laser-accurate so they are still dangerous but not aimbot nades.

mods.name: Exfil Flare Notification
mods.description: Notifies you when a flare extract is available / fired so you do not miss the window.

mods.name: SPT Mod Manager
mods.description: Desktop manager for installing and updating SPT mods from Forge. Not loaded in-raid; used to maintain the pack.

mods.name: Server Value Modifier
mods.description: All-in-one server config tool (raid time, loot, bots, traders, and more). CampD overrides are documented on the Pack Settings page.
mods.settingsNotes: See Pack Settings for SVM category notes as we fill them in.

mods.name: Sharper Tushonka Better Life
mods.description: Lightweight ReSHADE preset for sharper visuals without frying the UI. Dropped into the SPT root.
mods.settingsNotes: ReSHADE preset with ReSHADE preinstalled. Drop into root. Works with Amands's Graphics. Turn off sharpen in EFT settings.
